newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Four S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Canadian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Four S.Korean firms buy 50,000T Canadian wheat.

text.p: Four South Korean feed mill companies, including Cheiljedang Corp and Miwon Co Ltd, late on Wednesday bought 50,000 tonnes of Canadian feed wheat from Mitsubishi Corp, traders said on Thursday.
The wheat was purchased at $162.80 per tonne, C&F, they added.
Shipment was set for November 10-30, for arrival by December 15 at the western port city of Inchon.
